title: Student Loan Repayment Optimizer
description: Compares 5 federal repayment plans (Standard 10-yr, Graduated, Extended 25-yr, IBR, PAYE/ICR) across total cost, monthly payment trajectory, and PSLF eligibility. Calculates discretionary income for IDR plans using HHS FPL guidelines. PSLF tracker models 120-payment forgiveness timeline. Note: SAVE plan wound down mid-2026 and is excluded. Entirely deterministic.
